clips.title: The story
paras: Following Call to Arms, Korin Fel tells you that her husband is unaware of why Hammerfall is under attack, and asks you to slay the ogre Or'Kalar and bring her his head.

Korin Fel says you serve her husband well, yet he has no idea why Hammerfall is being attacked. The cause is Or'Kalar, Mug'thol's pawn in Stromgarde, who hates her husband for defeating him years ago and wants him dead. Her auguries tell her the ogre has set a trap for him.

Korin has hidden the signs of the ogre's presence from her husband, who she believes would rush off foolishly if he knew where Or'Kalar is. She asks for your help instead. You will find Or'Kalar near the Tower of Arathor, and she expects his death to end the attacks on Hammerfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You serve my husband well, adventurer, but he does not know why Hammerfall is under attack.
Or'Kalar, Mug'thol's pawn in Stromgarde, has an intense hatred for my husband, and wishes nothing more than my husband's death for defeating him years ago.
My auguries tell me that Or'Kalar has laid a trap for my husband, so I have hidden signs of the ogre's presence from him.
My husband will rush off foolishly if he learns of the ogre's whereabouts and I would ask for your help in slaying the creature.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Near the Tower of Arathor--that is where you will find Or'Kalar. His death will stop the attacks on Hammerfall and protect my husband's life.

I see in your eyes that you think me weak--even dishonorable--for my silence. Some day you will learn what it is to love as I do. Perhaps then you will understand a different kind of strength and honor.
In the meantime, do as I ask, and slay Or'Kalar.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done me a great service, friend. Know that my husband's life and the safety of Hammerfall has been protected for another day because of your deeds. Please take this as a reward for your courage.
